scope: Plant-based adaptation with pressed long-grain rice, firm tofu and coconut vegetables. The compressed rice reference uses two cups water per cup rice by volume; 250 g per 100 g dry rice is a compatible weight ratio. Cook until absorbed and soft, press in a 2 cm layer, chill rapidly, then reheat once until steaming throughout. Dry rice, edible trimmed produce and drained tofu are weighed. Full cooking-oil retention. No physical trial.
